gꜣḥ: gꜣḥ — to be weary, faint (?) (verb; written g + ḥ with a standing man with arms hanging as classifier, the ꜣ not written; Budge: ḳeḥ, 'be needy')
hꜣ-ḫrw: hꜣ-ḫrw — Ha-kheru, perhaps 'Descending of voice' (?) (from hꜣ 'go down' and ḫrw 'voice'; name of a gate's announcer; meaning doubtful; Budge: Ha-kheru)
mkt: mkt — protection (noun f.; with a genitive, mkt ḏḥwty 'the protection of Thoth'; Budge: māket, 'virtues')
mtty-ḥ: mtty-ḥ — Metety-he (?), name of a gate's watcher; the name is not understood and its last sign is uncertain (name of a demon; Budge: Metti-heh)
mꜣꜥtyw: mꜣꜥtyw — the gods of Maat (?), beings named from mꜣꜥt 'maat' (noun pl.; written with the god classifier; the spelling is unexplained and the meaning is a guess; Budge: Maāta, 'the Maāta gods')
qbb: qbb — the cool waters, the deep (?) (noun; written with g for q and one b; the reading is doubtful; Budge: ḳeb, 'the great deep')
qq-ḥwꜣwt-nt-pḥwy: qq-ḥwꜣwt-nt-pḥwy — Qeq-huaut-net-pehuy, 'Eater of the rot of the hindquarters' (from qq 'eat', ḥwꜣwt 'putrefaction', nt 'of', pḥwy 'hinder parts'; name of a doorkeeper; Budge: Qeq-ḥauatu-ent-peḥui)
rnpt: rnpt — year (noun f.; plural rnpwt 'years'; written with the palm-rib; Budge: renput)
rḏw: rḏw — efflux, the fluid that runs from a corpse (noun; the reading rests on a sign taken as the mountain ḏw; Budge: ertu, 'foul emanations')
smnḫ: smnḫ — to make excellent, set in order (verb; causative; sḏm·n·f smnḫ·n·i 'I have set in order'; Budge: semenχ)
snḏm: snḏm — to ease, soothe (verb; the causative of nḏm 'be sweet'; the nḏm sign is written in a doubtful form; Budge: senet'em)
spr: spr — to arrive, come (verb; infinitive after ḫft 'when', ḫft spr r 'when arriving at'; Budge: sper)
sqd-ḥr: sqd-ḥr — Seqed-her, perhaps 'Voyaging of face' (?) (from sqd 'travel by boat' and ḥr 'face'; name of a gate's watcher; a guess; Budge: Seqeṭ-ḥrà)
srs-ḥr: srs-ḥr — Seres-her, 'Watchful of face', 'Who keeps the face awake' (from srs 'awaken, make watchful', the causative of rs 'wake', and ḥr 'face'; name of a gate's watcher; the reading rests on an uncertain sign; Budge: Se-res-ḥrà)
sḫd-ḥr-ꜥšꜣ-irw: sḫd-ḥr-ꜥšꜣ-irw — Sekhed-her-asha-iru, perhaps 'Upside-down of face, many of forms' (?) (from sḫd 'be upside down', ḥr 'face', ꜥšꜣ 'many', irw 'forms'; name of a doorkeeper; the first half is doubtful; Budge: Sekhet-ḥrà-āsht-àru)
sḫḫ: sḫḫ — meaning unknown (a word not known otherwise, written s + ḫ + ḫ; Budge: seχeχ, 'made to balance')
sṯꜣ: sṯꜣ — to drag, draw along (verb; imperative sṯꜣ 'draw on!'; ṯ written with t; Budge: sta, 'lead on')
wn-ḥꜣt: wn-ḥꜣt — Wen-hat, perhaps 'Open of front' (?) (from wn 'open' and ḥꜣt 'front, brow'; name of a doorkeeper; how the two words join is not clear; Budge: Un-ḥāt)
wsd: wsd — Used (?), name of a gate's announcer; the name is not understood, and its classifiers point to cutting or force (name of a demon; Budge: Useṭ)
ḏꜥbt: ḏꜥbt — charcoal, burning coals (noun f.; Budge: t'ābet)
ḫmt: ḫmt — to think, intend; intention (?) (verb, used as a noun in m ḫmt; the meaning in its phrase is doubtful; written with three strokes and the arms held out; Budge: χemet, 'desire')
ḫmtnw: ḫmtnw — third (ordinal numeral; from ḫmt 'three'; feminine ḫmtnwt, written with the numeral and t; Budge: χemt)

__broaden__.ꜥryt: ꜥryt — door-frame, entrance; a part of the doorway, perhaps the lintel or a jamb (noun; Budge: ārit) · gate, gateway, gatehouse of the realm of Osiris (noun f.; written with the house sign as classifier; Budge: ārit, 'hall')
__broaden__.smi: smi — to report, announce, make known; to accuse (smi r 'report against'); to make petition (verb; infinitive smit); report, petition (noun) · noun: announcer, herald, the one who reports whoever arrives (Budge: semà)
__broaden__.sḫn: sḫn — to stir up, provoke · to embrace (?) (verb; infinitive written with embracing arms as classifier; the sense in its context is doubtful; Budge: seχen)
__broaden__.imi: imi — give! (imperative of rdi 'give') · also cause, let (before a sḏm·f: imi wn·i 'let me be'; with a passive, imi di·tw 'cause that there be given') · a second word of the same spelling: the negative verb "do not", im·k + negatival complement (im·k irt "you are not to make"; the use is doubtful)
__broaden__.wnḫ: wnḫ — to put on, clothe oneself in (verb; of garments) · to clothe, dress a person or cult object (verb; participle wnḫ "who clothes")
